# Atlas (2024 film)
**Atlas (2024 film)** , released on Netflix on May 24, 2024, is a science fiction action film directed by J.J. Abrams and starring Jennifer Lopez as Atlas Shepherd. The story is set in 2071, where Atlas, the daughter of Harlan Shepherd—the creator of the artificial intelligence terrorist Harlan—leads a military mission to capture the rogue AI Harlan, who has escaped to a planet in the Andromeda Galaxy. Accompanied by the military's ARC-equipped Rangers, Atlas falls to the planet after a crash landing and bonds with her ARC's onboard AI, Smith. Despite initial distrust of AI, Atlas and Smith work together to locate Harlan's base, where Atlas reveals that Harlan killed her mother due to Atlas's jealousy. Smith helps Atlas overcome her guilt, and with the sacrifice of Colonel Banks, they defeat Harlan in hand-to-hand combat. The film concludes with Atlas, now a ranger, testing a new ARC model that acknowledges the surviving sentience of Smith.
The production was primarily filmed in Los Angeles and New Zealand, with principal photography beginning in August 2022 and wrapping in November of the same year. The screenplay was originally written by Leo Sardarian, with rewrites performed by Aron Eli Coleite. Following its release, the film received generally unfavorable reviews from critics, scoring 37/100 on Metacritic and holding a 19% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Critics described it as a sci-fi spectacle that buckled under the weight of its script, though some praised Lopez's performance and the visual effects. The film was not nominated for major awards but was recognized for its sound editing at the Golden Reel Awards.
